title: Runtime Insight Tour — onboarding screenshot deck for telemetry quickstart
creator: Marina Lopez
assets: deck/01-hero-guided-tour.png: hero screen with callouts for latency, cost, and traces
deck/02-latency-heatmap.png: latency heatmap by region with SLO overlay
deck/03-token-cost-waterfall.png: token cost waterfall showing per-route breakdown
deck/04-trace-breadcrumb-modal.png: trace view modal with span-level timelines
deck/05-compare-sparkline.png: compact compare tiles for model variants
deck/06-mobile-compact.png: mobile responsive layout mockup for quickstart
design_notes:
Goal: produce a 6-slide screenshot deck for the onboarding quickstart that surfaces three measurable signals (p50/p95 latency, cost-per-token waterfall, and trace-level breadcrumbs) while keeping visuals digestible for first-time users.

Decisions: use a compact compare tile pattern to show model variants side-by-side rather than full charts to reduce cognitive load; prefer sparkline overlays on cards for trend context; place SLO bands on the heatmap to communicate targets early.

Trade-offs: full trace timelines are detailed but noisy—we surface a collapsed breadcrumb modal by default and enable expand-to-full-trace on click (engineering dependency ENG-3982). Token-cost waterfall uses stacked bars per route to show attribution (may require lightweight backend aggregation).

Accessibility: ensure color palettes pass AA contrast; include dashed patterns for SLO bands to be distinguishable for colorblind users.

Notes for engineering: use mocked telemetry for screenshots but instrument real SLO boundaries in follow-up implementation.
acceptance_criteria: 6 PNG assets exported at 2x resolution matching the asset list
Screenshots use production UI tokens and real-looking telemetry values (no PII)
Figma file contains editable components and a legend for each chart
Design review approved by PM and Eng and at least one UX researcher
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in the quickstart docs (Confluence)

screenshots_required: Latency heatmap: regional rows (us-west, us-east, eu-west) with p50/p95 overlays and SLO band
Token cost waterfall: per-route stacked bars showing inference tokens, prompt tokens, embedding tokens, and currency estimate
Trace breadcrumb modal: top-level spans with durations, ability to drill into KV-cache hits/misses
Model compare tiles: p50/p95, cost-per-token, and a 7d sparkline per model variant
Compact dashboard mobile: condensed cards showing latency and cost stacks for small screens
Onboarding hero overlay: guided tour pointers (3 steps) that highlight metrics and first actions
